body:
The parent of any slider is the same. I changed the enum that was not exposed to script to a private member.

 Additionally, `get_slider` always returns a valid slider, but intensity is not included. It's a bit unintuitive, but not a major issue.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d7bdd4b8335c1f4a17e90ebb233fd50318229b44/scene/gui/color_picker.cpp#L648-L653
Ideally the 0 magic number constantly won't be exposed. Not sure if we want to expose ColorPicker::SLIDER_COUNT, but at least the 0 constant needs to be wrapped.
For me `SLIDER_COUNT`(3) is more like a mistake. The actual slider count is `SLIDER_MAX` (5).
Fortunately `get_slider` is not exposed to the script, so I can fix its behavior. I think `get_slider(0)->get_parent()` can be wrapped into a alone method, such as `get_slider_container()`.
